results.label: every action refuses an unknown or missing revision before any write
the pause action on an idle timer is a conflict and writes nothing
the resume action on an idle timer is a conflict and writes nothing
the complete action on an idle timer is a conflict and writes nothing
the cancel action on an idle timer is a conflict and writes nothing
start refuses an unlisted bell interval, an unlisted ambience and a mixed length
start refuses an intention over the character cap or with control characters
a valid start is accepted once
a write replayed with a consumed revision is a conflict, never a second write
a paused timer refuses a second pause and a resume starts from paused
a running timer refuses a second resume

scope: M108 practice hardening, rollback and no-authority proof: actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM, fixedUTC and tiny raster/literal journals; not real chart/provider/broker/pixel/production or mental-state proof
